Extensions `cv_read_dataset_file()` actually dispatches on.

Source: R/agent_ingest.R
CV_UPLOAD_EXTS.Rd

Kept beside that switch deliberately, and asserted against it by a test: a format added to the reader and not to this vector would be REFUSED at upload before the reader ever saw it, which is a far more confusing failure than the one this exists to prevent.

Usage

CV_UPLOAD_EXTS

Format

An object of class character of length 10.

Details

`h5` is included even when `hdf5r` is absent. Refusing it here would replace the reader's specific, actionable message ("install hdf5r, or export as 10x MTX") with a generic list of formats – the pre-check exists to save the user an upload, not to give a worse answer than the code behind it.
